environment.description: ECS Fargate task (platform 1.4.0) with custom AppArmor-equivalent confinement via Fargate's built-in runtime protection layer. The task definition specifies a dockerSecurityOpt with a custom profile reference 'apparmor:ecs-ws-confined' which on Fargate 1.4.0+ maps to the platform's integrated LSM enforcement. The profile restricts file read access to /tmp/ws_uploads/** and /proc/self/status only, with explicit deny on path traversal patterns (/../) at the kernel mediation layer. Additionally, the profile sets 'deny /etc/** r' and 'deny /home/** r' rules. The container runs as non-root uid 1000 with a read-only root filesystem. Note: Fargate's LSM integration does not use traditional AppArmor userspace tooling but enforces equivalent mandatory access control via the platform's sandboxing mechanism (based on firecracker microVM boundary + additional in-guest profile enforcement added in platform version 1.4.0 security patch Q3-2023).
